---
title: "SCNSim Documentation"
description: "Notebook-first documentation for superconducting circuit network simulation."
---

SCNSim documents one public product boundary: a reusable Python package for
circuit-network authoring, compilation, reduction, Direct/HB analysis,
optimization, typed results, and receipt-backed reporting.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Candidate semantics

The product and Runtime contracts remain `CONVERGING`. The installable package
is a fail-fast API/docstring scaffold; compiler, solver, unit-registry,
workspace, and report behavior are not yet implemented, accepted, stabilized,
or released.
:::

## Choose your path

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .border .rounded .p-3}
### Use an existing circuit model

Start with the [simple model-user workflow](../examples/simple_resonator/02_model_user.qmd).
It shows how a notebook consumer supplies a target and workspace without
repeating topology, Ports, objectives, or optimizer controls.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .border .rounded .p-3}
### Develop a reusable model

Start with the [simple model-author workflow](../examples/simple_resonator/01_model_author.qmd),
then read [Component Authoring](component-authoring.qmd). This path owns the
Plan, components, electric nodes, logical Ports, reusable Specs, and team façade.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .border .rounded .p-3}
### Review Runtime behavior

Read the [V1 Runtime Contract](v1-runtime-contract.qmd) for the exact
Plan/Ref/Run/Spec/Result boundary, Direct and HB response surfaces, physical
quantity evaluation, optimization, resolution, receipts, and failures.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .border .rounded .p-3}
### Review a complete optimization workflow

Use the [IPF model-author workflow](../examples/ipf_optimization/01_model_author.qmd)
and [model-user workflow](../examples/ipf_optimization/02_model_user.qmd) to
trace general N-trace RLGC through a reusable Composite, five-variable Direct
optimization, winner reuse, pump-off HB, reporting, and exact resolution.
:::
:::

## How the documentation is divided

| Surface | Owns |
| --- | --- |
| [Component Authoring](component-authoring.qmd) | Library identity, component catalog, pins, electric nodes, logical Ports, parameters, RLGC, composites, and backend realization |
| [V1 Runtime Contract](v1-runtime-contract.qmd) | Execution, views, Specs, Direct/HB, evaluation, optimization, typed Results, receipts, and failure behavior |
| Model-author QMD workflows | Complete reusable-model construction and packaging narratives; paired IPYNBs are generated transport artifacts |
| Model-user QMD workflows | Short consumer workflows over a team-owned façade; paired IPYNBs are generated transport artifacts |
| [SCQ Design Kit Knowledge](https://github.com/arfiligol/SCQ_Design/tree/main/docs/knowledge) | Canonical reusable physics, mathematics, engineering meaning, and numerical-method derivations |

The product pages link to Knowledge rather than copying its formulas. The QMD
workflows call the proposed public API rather than creating a second Runtime
contract; generated Notebooks provide GitHub and Jupyter transport only.

## Suggested review order

1. Review the [component model](component-authoring.qmd#one-library-model),
   [electrical topology](component-authoring.qmd#electrical-topology-and-logical-ports),
   [general RLGC](component-authoring.qmd#general-rlgc), and
   [declarative composites](component-authoring.qmd#declarative-composites).
2. Continue with the Runtime [Notebook mental model](v1-runtime-contract.qmd#notebook-mental-model)
   and [`solve()` versus `evaluate()`](v1-runtime-contract.qmd#solve-versus-evaluate).
3. Review [unified node views](v1-runtime-contract.qmd#shared-topology-and-unified-node-views),
   [Direct quantities](v1-runtime-contract.qmd#direct-matrices-and-physical-quantities),
   [optimization](v1-runtime-contract.qmd#optimization-and-numerical-scaling),
   and [HB drives/cases/mixing](v1-runtime-contract.qmd#named-hb-drives-cases-and-mixing).
4. Finish with the Runtime's [open Human decisions](v1-runtime-contract.qmd#open-human-decisions).

::: {.callout-important}
## Human acceptance remains explicit

Package import, CI, Quarto rendering, and review can reject malformed candidate
bytes. They cannot accept SCNSim semantics or promote this development package
to a stable product line.
:::
